messages:
OpsBot: ALERT detected: GPU prefill OOMs on cluster-gamma (node-17, node-19). 5xx rate spike and container restarts observed. Trigger: prefill_vram_spike threshold. @pager on-call notified :rotating_light:
Jordan (on-call): I’m on it, paging from mobile. diving in now.
Maya SRE: quick context — we started seeing a surge of very long prompts from a single tenant hitting the dedicated hotpool. Prefill memory climbs past 95% then container restarts.
Sam (runtime): logs show repeated CUDA out-of-memory on llm-worker before SIGKILL. stack: `cudaFree` bursts + kvcache growth. Suspect long-window prefill + kvcache never trimmed.
Jordan (on-call): mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefill window to 4096 tokens for hotpool 2) enable prefix trimming 3) route new requests to cold-model fallback. Rolling change now.
Sam (runtime): I’ll flip the runtime flag to enable aggressive kv-eviction: `REDWOOD_PREFILL_KV_EVICTION=aggressive` on hotpool autoscaler group. Doing `kubectl patch` now.
Sam (runtime): command run:
```
kubectl -n inference patch deployment hotpool-gamma --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"runtime.prefill.kv_eviction":"aggressive"}}}}}'
```
Jordan (on-call): also applied request-level cap via gateway: `x-redwood-max-prefill: 4096` for hotpool routes. Watching.
OpsBot: Deploybot: rollout started for hotpool-gamma (3/3 pods updated).
Elena (CSE): customer impact check: Support reported a downstream timeout for Customer X on /chat-stream around 12:04 UTC, likely affected. I’m escalating to CSE to notify.
Maya SRE: status so far: node-17 still flapping but new pods land on other nodes. prefills per-second dropped 60%. no new OOMs in the last 30s on updated pods.
Jordan (on-call): manual eviction of stuck kvcache on node-17 to avoid noisy neighbor: `rdctl evict-kv --node node-17 --force` — completed.
Sam (runtime): confirmed: CUDA OOMs stopped on updated pods, a single straggler hit but auto-restarted and came back clean.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Jordan (on-call).
Jordan (on-call): immediate mitigations applied. Preparing runbook steps for follow-up: - tune kvcache heuristics - add per-tenant prefill caps - telemetry for long prompt sources - consider prefetch coldmodel fallback thresholds.
Elena (CSE): Sent first customer note: "We saw transient errors earlier; mitigation in progress; no persistent data loss; follow-up soon."
Maya SRE: next actions: postmortem owner = Sam, timeline capture, grab dmesg + runtime traces from node-17, correlate tenant IDs for surge.
Jordan (on-call): marking incident as MONITORING. Will update in 15m or sooner. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: ALERT cleared for ongoing OOMs — no new OOM signatures for 5m.
Jordan (on-call): last check: throughput normalized, hotpool healthy. handing to Sam for post-incident analysis and to Elena for customer comms. Closing pager for now but keeping channel open.
